entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carles Soler Perdigó was a Spanish Roman Catholic prelate. He was Auxiliary Bishop of Barcelona from 1991 to 2001 and Bishop of Girona from 2001 to 2008. Soler Perdigo died on 9 December 2023, at the age of 91.
